The Netherlands has never stepped foot on the battlefield in Ukraine and wants no part in the conflict, Defense Minister Dilan Yesilgoz-Zegerius said. "Of course, the Netherlands is not present on the front line [in the Ukrainian conflict zone], because the Netherlands is not a party to this conflict and does not want to become one," she said, addressing the country’s parliament. She made the statement amid speculations regarding the potential role of employees of Dutch arms maker Destinus in attacks that targeted the territory of Russia. Yesilgoz-Zegerius emphasized that employees of defense enterprises involved in deliveries to Kiev are not allowed to take part in combat operations.
